edges.method: Analytic fillet-arc-center method on the re-imported STL (verify.py measure_tip_fillet / circle_fit / solve_fillet_radius). Tip corners (4 samples: OD/ID x 2 tips): mid-height (Z=12mm) horizontal section, Kasa least-squares circle fit to the 6 boundary points nearest the theoretical (pre-fillet) sharp-corner-offset center. Top rim (2 samples, angles 100/260deg, clear of both tip fillets and the mounting-flange footprint): single-height radius-offset at h=0.05mm below the top face, analytically inverted via the exact quarter-round offset formula r=(offset+h)+sqrt(2*offset*h). Flange outer corners (2 samples): same circle-fit method as the tip corners, applied to the flange's 90deg flat-flat corner at the same mid-height section.
edges.evidence: verify.py section 7 (stdout + verify_output.json keys e01_tip_fillet_samples / e01_top_rim_od_fillet_samples / e01_flange_corner_samples)

edges.method: Horizontal-run measurement at a fixed low height (Z=0.05mm) on the re-imported STL, restricted to angles/regions confirmed (by direct radius-vs-angle inspection of the mesh) to sit on the ring's own plain circular OD or the flange's own flat outer face, clear of the region where the two geometries' footprints overlap and a naive per-angle offset formula would be invalid. run = (nominal_position - measured_position_at_z) + z, exact for a 45deg chamfer.
